set.body:
Outcome: qualify the landed live-study CLI against the real OpenAI API on authored synthetic geometric events, then replay offline with exact mapping/unit equality and zero HTTP calls.
User authorized reusing existing OPENAI_API_KEY for at most three HTTP requests and no participant data. Do not persist or print credentials. One session, one chunk, one client invocation, mapping attempts=1; existing transport allows at most two retries (three HTTP attempts total). maxTokens512, timeout30000ms. Pinned model gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14, endpoint https://api.openai.com/v1.
Runtime base e20eff4ca4d8accec9174819d37e4fd537ae20ea; unchanged implementation c4238aa3f3ed1e82b6e66890c661b822a0213404. No new source code planned. All raw synthetic inputs and responses remain in ignored data/.provider-smoke/20261115. Public result records counts, hashes, limits, exact runtime and hosted outcomes.
Success: live command exits0, actual HTTP attempts<=3, receipt captures provider model/usage, both original unit keys and expected assignments survive, separate replay process without API credentials reports0 calls/0 HTTP and identical units/interpretations. Independent evidence and exact documentation-SHA review; publish qualified receipt and leave main clean. A provider/account refusal is reported as a blocker, not a passed smoke or an implementation regression.
set.title: Qualify live study execution against a real provider and offline replay
